name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Type to filter options, then pick one like a select. Large catalogs where search beats scrolling.

discovery.name: Combobox
discovery.description: Type to filter options, then pick one like a select. Large catalogs where search beats scrolling.

configurables.what: Whether the first option is highlighted as the user types.
configurables.how: true for short lists (<20); false when accidental Enter would pick a wrong option.

gotchas.note: Compose Combobox + ComboboxInput + ComboboxContent/Item; controlled mode needs value/onValueChange and often open/onOpenChange.
Portal content can mismatch on first paint in Next — mount the open list on the client.
Pair with Field label; keep keyboard arrows/Enter/Escape working — do not replace the input with a non-textbox.

agent.usage:
import { Combobox, ComboboxInput, ComboboxContent, ComboboxItem } from '@/components/molecules/Combobox';

<Combobox value={v} onValueChange={setV}>
  <ComboboxInput placeholder="Search country" />
  <ComboboxContent>
    <ComboboxItem value="mx">Mexico</ComboboxItem>
    <ComboboxItem value="us">United States</ComboboxItem>
  </ComboboxContent>
</Combobox>
